case.title: Wood build
case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

messages: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

qualification.reason: Saved witness passes current machine gates; human task review remains pending.

reviewQuestions: Are materials grounded and quantities sufficient?
Are steps complete and captions faithful?
Does the final result follow from shown operations?

design.purpose: A weatherproof-looking open planter for herbs or flowers for one gardener, with at least 15 cm soil depth above the base.

steps.c: Lay the wide board flat for cutting.
Cut a 50 cm base; keep the 69.7 cm offcut.
Lay the second board flat for cutting.
Cut front and back, each 50 cm long.
Lay the narrow board flat for cutting.
Cut two ends, each 16 cm long.
Drill two drainage holes through the base.
Place the 50 cm base flat on the floor.
Stand the front on the base front edge.
Stand the back on the base back edge.
Fit the left end between front and back.
Fit the right end between front and back.
Sand all cut edges smooth.
Drive screws through front into left end (2 screws)
Drive screws through front into right end (2 screws)
Drive screws through back into left end (2 screws)
Drive screws through back into right end (2 screws)
Drive screws up through base into front (2 screws)
Drive screws up through base into back (2 screws)
Drive one screw up into each end (2 screws)
